title: Anthropic opens source Claude Commerce Agents
summary: Anthropic releases the source code for Claude Commerce Agents, providing a foundation for building trading agents and seller agents with working examples for retail, travel, telecom, and entertainment. The blog post details architecture, latency and cost reduction, quality evaluation approaches, and includes a reference implementation with buyer/seller agents, four industry demos, and a Claude Code plugin.
